offering_description.value: Provides a cloud software platform and data analytics that auto insurers, collision repair shops and other automotive businesses use to estimate, settle and manage vehicle insurance claims. Earns money mainly through subscriptions and per-transaction fees.

primary_products.value: claims management software; vehicle estimating software; total loss valuation software; automotive parts pricing data

primary_services.value: total loss valuation; claims processing; repair management; parts procurement

customer_segment.value: B2B: auto insurers, collision repair shops, automotive parts suppliers, auto manufacturers, salvage and vehicle auction businesses

end_markets.value: auto insurance; collision repair; automotive aftermarket; vehicle total loss and salvage

revenue_model.value: subscription: software subscriptions paid by insurers and repair shops; transaction or usage fees: per-claim, per-estimate and data transaction fees; service fees: claims and total loss valuation services
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: cloud claims platform that takes in claims and vehicle data and sells to insurers and repairers; service provider: claims and valuation services sold to insurers

geography_served.value: global: primarily US, also Canada, UK, Europe, Japan and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: claims software, total loss valuation, estimating and repair workflow, parts pricing data

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to national and regional insurers and repair networks; online: cloud-hosted software accessed by customers over the internet

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: customer data privacy laws and insurance claims rules affect handling of vehicle and claims data
